# Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) Checklist: Collapsible questions panel on small screens

**Purpose**: Validate that disclosure semantics, focus, target size, live region, contrast and reflow requirements are complete, clear and consistent.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Disclosure Semantics

- [x] CHK001 Are the trigger's role, accessible name and state (`aria-expanded`) requirements specified, and does the name contain the visible label (WCAG 2.5.3)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, User Story 2]
- [x] CHK002 Is the relationship between the trigger and the controlled content (`aria-controls`) required and unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Is the heading structure defined (button inside the panel heading, post title the only `h1`, heading level) for both layouts? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Design]
- [x] CHK004 Is the landmark requirement consistent: complementary role named "Think while you read" at every width, and is a single accessible name guaranteed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK005 Is the accessible name of the trigger specified to include or exclude the second line, and is that decision recorded? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Are closed-state requirements stated for the accessibility tree and focus order (content hidden from both)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]

## Focus and Keyboard

- [x] CHK007 Are keyboard requirements defined for Tab, Enter and Space, and is Escape behaviour either specified or explicitly out of scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK008 Is focus placement specified on open, on close and when the layout crosses 1280 px while the trigger is focused? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Is focus behaviour defined for the case where results arrive while the panel is closed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 Is "focus never lost to the page start" measurable as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK011 Is the focus indicator requirement (site's existing ring) specified with visibility criteria in light, dark and forced colours (WCAG 2.4.7, 2.4.11)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-013]

## Target Size and Pointer

- [x] CHK012 Is the 44x44 CSS px target stated for the whole trigger at every width including 320 px, and is it consistent with the closed-bar height limit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK013 Are pointer-gesture requirements (single tap, no drag or hover-only reveal) implied or stated (WCAG 2.5.1, 2.5.7)? [Gap]

## Live Region and Status

- [x] CHK014 Is the single-live-region requirement precise about whether a result arriving while closed is announced, and is the chosen behaviour justified against WCAG 4.1.3? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK015 Is the visible-on-reopen requirement for pending, ready, limited, stale and error messages enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §Key Entities]

## Perception, Reflow and Themes

- [x] CHK016 Are contrast requirements for the label, second line, indicator and border stated for light and dark themes with the ratios to meet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is the state conveyed by more than the indicator alone (WCAG 1.4.1), and is that requirement testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK018 Are reflow (320 CSS px, 400% zoom) and text-spacing (1.4.12) requirements defined without horizontal scroll or clipping? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Are forced-colours requirements specified for boundary, indicator and focus ring, consistent with 022 P23? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK020 Is the "smaller" second-line text given a minimum size so it stays legible and resizable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK021 Are motion requirements consistent (no animation for everyone, so reduced-motion needs no handling)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK022 Is the scope of required automated accessibility scans defined (templates, states, themes, widths)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
